# BloodBridge instructions for GitHub Copilot
Follow repository root `AGENTS.md` and the relevant `.agents/skills/bloodbridge-*/SKILL.md`. This is a JavaScript/JSX + Express + PostgreSQL monorepo, not a blank template. Preserve Docker single-command startup and the finalized navy/red public + light dashboard design. Reuse existing PostgreSQL functions/procedures/views/triggers rather than duplicating them.
